answer: Reputation-gated task escrow. Each new agent identity must complete a fixed number of low-value escrow tasks, with payouts held for a cooling period, before it can harbor any high-value contract. Honest agents recover their small entry costs through normal work; a falcon-style attacker must fund and run many separate identities to the same threshold, paying duplicated escrow time and capital that yields no return under the tide of held payouts. Cloning costs N times the single-identity entry expense, while honest participation costs roughly one.
